regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and Supporting Information statement
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate NBS cyclization/downstream-application claims were inspected. The PDF says SI is available online, but workspace source_mapping.json keeps SI association unestablished; no SI facts were imported.

regions.region: page 1 lower-left Scheme 1
regions.finding: Known beta-amino-alcohol/beta-hydroxy-amide routes and the generic current X+ allene approach are conceptual/cited method classes, not uniquely specified preparative experiments; classified as one general_scheme record.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right Results and Discussion start
regions.finding: The initial 1a/I2/CH3CN experiment is Table 1 entry 1 and is linked to that optimization record rather than duplicated; page 1 supplies the 46% crude 1H-NMR context.

unresolved: Scheme 1 has generic R/X groups and no experiment-level quantities or yields.
No Supporting Information file is explicitly associated.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1, entries 1–12 and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: All twelve solvent/electrophile rows were retained independently with 1a/X+ amounts, total solvent volume, argon, time, temperature override, NMR yield/basis, and 8%/10% recovered 1a footnotes. Mixed MeCN/H2O ratios remain source ratios.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2, entries 1–6 and footnotes
regions.finding: All six NBS-loading rows were retained separately with 1a scale, NBS equivalents, MeCN volume, room temperature, row times, NMR yields, and internal-standard basis.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Table 3, entries 1–10 and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten 1a–1j scope rows were mapped to the matching detailed 2a–2j records and merged with pages 4–5 rather than duplicated; each has its own time and isolated yield.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right prose introducing Scheme 2
regions.finding: The 2k–2o scope discussion continues to page 3. The 26% 2o outcome with unidentified side product is linked cross-page; no additional experiment is invented from the prose.

unresolved: SI-only solvent-drying procedures are unavailable and were not inferred.
Optimization rows omit workups, purifications, and isolated masses.

regions.region: page 3 top equations (1) and (2)
regions.finding: Distinct 5.1 mmol gram-scale 1m-to-2m run (45 min, 0.9801 g, 67%) and double bromocyclization 1p-to-2p (10 min, 56%) were retained separately; the gram run is not merged with the 1.0 mmol 2m scope row.

regions.region: page 3 center-left Scheme 2
regions.finding: Five standard-condition scope arrows 1k–1o were merged with matching detailed compound paragraphs on pages 5–6. Times/yields were preserved and the unknown 2o side product remains an explicit product observation.

regions.region: page 3 center-right Scheme 3
regions.finding: Six downstream experiments were retained: TBAF·3H2O eliminations to 3a–3c and CuI/Et2NH/K3PO4/indole couplings to 4a–4c, with row-specific yields and times. Footnote-style loadings are structured as participants/amounts.

regions.region: page 3 conclusion and General Information start
regions.finding: Conclusion adds no new experiment. General Information supplies shared dry-Schlenk and solvent-drying context; SI-unassociated details are not inferred or promoted to every row without explicit procedure linkage.

unresolved: Scheme-only 3c and 4a–4c records omit some scales, workups, purifications, masses, and/or yield bases on pages 1–6.
No mechanistic intermediates are drawn or claimed as isolated on this page.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left General Information
regions.finding: Shared solvent drying, analytical, chromatography, TLC, and literature-preparation statements were reviewed as context; they do not form independent reactions. The allene-amide starting materials are cited as prepared by literature procedure 12.

regions.region: page 4 left-column Typical Procedure I for 2a
regions.finding: The 1.0 mmol 1a/NBS experiment was merged with Table 3 entry 1 and retains exact masses, MeCN volume, argon, room-temperature/TLC operation, workup, chromatography, 162.9 mg, and 64% isolated yield.

regions.region: page 4 left-column preparative 2a-prime procedure
regions.finding: A distinct 6.4 mmol NIS experiment at room temperature for 5 h gives 2a-prime, 0.7358 g, 38% isolated. It is not Table 1 entry 11, which uses a different scale/time and reports NMR yield.

regions.region: page 4 right column compound paragraphs 2b–2e
regions.finding: The detailed 1.0 mmol quantities, purification ratios, masses and isolated yields for 2b–2e were merged with Table 3 entries 2–5; page-5 continuation of 2e is characterization only.

unresolved: The detailed paragraphs primarily report preparation and characterization; spectroscopic peak lists were not promoted into reaction fields.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left continuation of 2e characterization
regions.finding: Characterization continuation only; it supports the existing 2e identity and does not define another preparation.

regions.region: page 5 left and right columns, compound paragraphs 2f–2l
regions.finding: Seven detailed 1.0 mmol preparations (2f–2l) were merged with Table 3/Scheme 2 rows. Exact substrate/NBS masses, MeCN volume, purification ratios, product masses and isolated yields were retained.

unresolved: The 2l characterization continues on page 6 but supplies no second reaction.
No SI-only operational details were inferred.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left continuation of 2l characterization and 2m paragraph
regions.finding: 2l characterization continuation is not a new run. The standard 1.0 mmol 2m scope experiment (228.9 mg, 76%) remains separate from the following gram-scale experiment.

regions.region: page 6 left-column Gram-Scale Synthesis of 2m
regions.finding: The complete 5.1 mmol/45 min procedure, workup, chromatography, 0.9801 g mass, and 67% isolated yield were retained as a distinct reported experiment.

regions.region: page 6 lower-left and upper-right compound paragraphs 2n–2p
regions.finding: The standard 2n and 2o scope experiments and 2p double cyclization were merged with page-3 arrows. The unknown side product accompanying 2o is preserved without invented identity or yield.

regions.region: page 6 lower-right Typical Procedure II and start of 3b
regions.finding: The full 3a elimination procedure and the page-6 portion of 3b were merged with Scheme 3: exact masses, DMF volume, 100 °C, scheme times, purification, product masses, and 82% yields are retained. Page 7 characterization was not used or claimed covered.

unresolved: The 3b characterization continues on page 7 and was not imported.
The unknown side product in the 2o experiment is not identified or quantified.
